answer: Bind every identity to a commit-reveal loyalty ledger: before seeing the payload, an agent signs a commitment to its next batch and reveals it later. The commitment climbs a vine of consecutive epochs, and any wander off-protocol resets the clock to zero. A sybil farm cannot graft one honest chain onto many heads, because each reveal must be signed by key material tied to the original hardware. A willow of rotating witness slots re-checks a sample; a signer who vouches for a clone forfeits its own slot. Fake heads never inherit depth, and depth is the only path to credit.
